itemList.itemCode: PWD SR Vol-02, 2023-24, Item no. 12.88, Page No.11
itemList.description: Providing & fixing of 2-track x 2-panel sliding windows made out of multi chambered UPVC(Matching to RAL 9016) sections and with minimum TiO2(Titanium Dioxide) at 6PHR with TPE(Thermo Plastic Elastomer) and lead free, gaskets -grey colour having isolated drainage and reinforced with Galvanized Iron profile through-out the window frame. The outer frame having a overall size of 60mm width x 45mmheight with reinforcement of 1mm thickness and Sash with overall size of 39mm X 58mm with GI reinforcement of 1mm for the frame and 1.5 mm for the sash. Coextruded Glazing bead for fixing of glass shall be of size 20mm x 24mm. Windows shall be provided with 5mm plain float glass, standard hardware& single point locking system with touch lock. Wall thickness of frame & sash shall be of 2-2.5 mm. Maximum possible size 1819mm x 1819mm (The cost s inclusive of all fixtures and separate charges for minor T P s shall not be made) (PWD SR Vol-02, 2023-24, Item no. 12.88, Page No.110)
